basic_info.description: Positioned quietly at the rear of a handsome 1920s four-unit building, 1205 Oak St. #2 is a generously sized one-bedroom plus office offering rare indoor-outdoor flow and a surprising sense of calm in the middle of the city. The spacious living/dining area features original hardwood floors, charming period details, and bright south-facing light. From here, gaze out onto a lush shared garden - an inviting, verdant backdrop that softens daily life. Step directly outside for a coffee, a glass of wine under the trees, or an evening soak in the clawfoot tub. The large updated kitchen is modernized with granite counters, stainless appliances, and space for dining. A flexible den or office creates an ideal spot for remote work or hosting guests, while the quiet, generously sized bedroom offers true comfort. Conveniences include side-by-side garage parking, deeded storage, shared laundry, and seismic upgrades completed in 2016. Set in a well-maintained building at the nexus of Duboce, Alamo Square, NoPa, and the Haight, this home is surrounded by some of the city's best restaurants, markets, and cafes. Grab groceries across the street at Falletti, cocktails at Horsefeather, and enjoy having Che Fico and Stoa just minutes away.
